source_basis.canonical_relation_policy: Evidence-only comparison; no harmonization, dependence, direction, shared event or identity, chronology, history, fulfillment, doctrine, canon hierarchy, source priority, or boundary authority.

coverage_contract.routing_principle: Prefer complete list, narrative scene, discourse movement, controversy, parable, passion, tomb, and commission parents; retain adjacent merges and key internal splits as appeals.

tiers.guard: No external Second Temple primary source was used here; a future source may inform context but cannot dictate boundaries, identity, fulfillment, theology, or history
Any reconstruction must be labeled modern, cite its evidence chain, expose uncertainty, and remain non-authoritative for seams
Mark, Luke, John, Acts, epistles, and Revelation are mapped as canonical relations only; no date, direction, dependence, or harmonization follows
Requires source-specific dating, redaction and transmission controls; never automatically represents Jesus, Matthew, Pharisees, scribes, or first-century Judaism
May document medieval reception or comparison only; not direct Second Temple or first-century context
Cannot be back-projected as the meaning, practice, institution, or voice of Matthew's narrated groups
May generate questions and risks but cannot authorize history, theology, canon, identity, fulfillment, preferred reading, or literary boundaries
